plugins.name: bookwright
plugins.description: Per-chapter and status tooling for the

Quarto book. A book-conductor that tracks chapter status and routes open work, book-style (enforces STYLE.md), book-enrich (applies ENRICHMENT.md), book-figure, book-review (a six-critic chapter panel), and book-continuity.
